description: Slide-deck shell implementing prompts/deck.md: 1920x1080 scale-to-fit, keyboard + click navigation, 1-indexed counter and #slide=N, td:slide / td:slide-changed, speaker notes, print one page per slide. Wrap <section data-td-slide data-td-screen="01 Title"> elements in <deck-stage>.
Two or more static options side by side inside one board, with labels, notes, a Recommended badge and Fit / 100% zoom.
iPhone-style device frame (390x844 screen): bezel, island, status bar, home indicator, safe areas, light/dark, fit-to-board scaling.
Android-style device frame (412x915 screen): punch-hole camera, status bar, gesture pill or 3-button nav, safe areas, light/dark, fit-to-board scaling.
Desktop-app window chrome: traffic lights, unified title bar + toolbar, optional translucent sidebar, light/dark, fit-to-board scaling.
Brand-neutral browser chrome around a website: tab strip, toolbar, address bar with padlock, scrolling page viewport, light/dark, fit-to-board scaling.

Timeline animation stage per prompts/kinds/animation.md: fixed-size scaled stage, Sprite start/end, easing set, interpolate (numbers/colours), entry/exit helpers, scrubber with play/pause/markers, #t= persistence, window.tdTimeline {duration, fps, seek, play, pause} for MP4 export.
